verdict.rationale: Wise documents domestic and cross-border payment tools and business payments from a Wise account, so paying vendors domestically is within its documented capability. However, no evidence names outbound domestic ACH or domestic wire as payout rails. The only ACH reference covers funding batch transfers via direct debit, which is inbound and not credited here. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of outbound ACH payouts, explicit documentation of domestic wire sends, vendor/recipient payment workflow detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send domestic ACH and wire payments to vendors
